So now I get to sit here knowing I’ll be auto‑enrolled into whatever mystery fees Planty decides to charge, and my bank can’t do a thing until they actually take the money. Love that for me.

title: Deleted in less than 5min
text:
First thing the app did was want/force me to enter my garden info (no clear option to skip).  After getting through that process and getting a chance to test how and how well it worked at identifying plants, I took a pic of a hop plant to see if it would guess the variety (there are many).  Its first guess was grapes with hops being a second guess (no varietal guess).  Not too impressive... 
When looking at what it said about hops and the general flow in that "info" feature, I found the interface to be very limiting and not straightforward.
BUT the main reason for quickly giving up and deleting was that all during the less than stellar described experience I kept getting requests to make a review ("give some love" was one obnoxious way it asked - "but we just met").  It started within less than a minute and came up every 30sec or so.

Well there's the review and here's some constructive feedback:
- Don't have the garden info input be something that automatically comes up (ever). Have it be an option...
- First thing up should be a question if you want a tutorial on how to use and the features of app.
- Don't ask for a review until a number of hours have been logged using the app.  And have respectful the "no thanks" button
